observations: Photo 0, 1, 2 show the same orange gas cylinder from different angles, standing among other cylinders in a storage area.
Photo 2 shows embossed/printed text on the cylinder shoulder including the word 'REPSOL' and a number resembling '12,5' (capacity in kg).
The cylinder body has scuffed paint, scratches, and a worn/discolored handle area (photo 0) suggesting age and handling wear.
A brass-colored valve is fitted at the top (photo 0, 1); it shows some tarnish/patina rather than a bright new finish.
No visible test certificate, hydrostatic test stamp date, or leak-test sticker is legible in any photo.
Background shows other cylinders (red, blue) that are not the item being sold, based on the buyer's description of a single 12.5kg cylinder.
Bottom ring of the cylinder in photo 2 shows a small hole/vent typical of cylinder base design, with some rust-toned residue nearby.

claims.evidence: Repsol branding in photo 2 suggests foreign origin, but 'foreign-used' condition history cannot be confirmed remotely.
Marketing language, not a checkable fact from photos.

claims.claim: Recently tested and certified, no leak
claims.evidence: No certificate, stamp, or test date visible in any photo.
Valve in photo 0 and 1 shows tarnish/patina consistent with some use, not clearly a new part; no close-up or packaging shown.

risks.risk: Hydrostatic test/expiry date stamped on the cylinder collar may show it is overdue for retesting, which affects legality and refill eligibility.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the collar stamp showing manufacture/test date.
risks.if_unproven: priced as due or overdue for retest

risks.risk: Actual leak status of valve and body seams is unknown despite the 'no leak' claim.
risks.proof: Video of a soap-water bubble test on valve and seams under pressure.

risks.risk: Valve may be old/worn rather than new as claimed, affecting safety and resale value.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of valve markings/manufacture date or receipt for valve replacement.

risks.risk: Internal corrosion or wall thinning from long foreign use is not visible from outside photos.
risks.proof: Service/inspection report or weight check against standard tare weight.

risks.risk: Dent near handle (photo 0) could indicate impact damage affecting structural integrity.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the dented area from multiple angles.

proof_requests: Close-up of the manufacture/test date stamp on the cylinder collar.
Video of a soapy-water leak test on the valve and seams.
Close-up of the valve showing any manufacture markings or new-part packaging/receipt.
Photo of the cylinder on a scale showing tare weight (for corrosion/wall-thickness check).
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a 12.5kg Repsol-branded LPG gas cylinder, but the seller's safety claims (tested, no leak, new valve) are unverified from photos, so it must be priced at worst case pending proof.
